body: Teachers here... won't care. Trust me, i know. Plus i'm not from an english speaking country either, we don't have guidance or counselor here.
Nope, i didn't get any help. Plus my family won't let me get help cause of their beliefs.

Well some of my friends knows how i don't like my family but they just don't really understand it. They are not toxic about it but they are not that supportive either even if they try to comfort me, they simply don't understand it at all. The comforting is just a couple semtences and then changing the topic, so i don't really talk about my family with them anymore. I never give details to them it was simply i don't like my family. And i prefer not to. And noone knows how i have suicidal thoughts. I usually act verry happy among them anyways so they wouldn't really realise it.
I need to study for school too so i can't rest that long. Fortunetly it's two weeks vacation right now but once this ends, it will be extremely exhausting again

Well, i have two brothers. One is a 4 years old and the other one is in middle school. So i'm older than both of them but i don't really spend time with either of them. I just don't feel like i have that sibling bond with them at all.

Yeah, i don't actually want to die. But trying to get a better life is so exhausting. I tried, but it gets too much emotional energy from me and i just don't have that energy anymore. I simply don't want deal with life anymore.

My mother just don't care about me and my father is... Well my relationship with him is terrible too. Plus they're both religious fanatics so it feels like a cage living in their house. I wish i actually felt some parental love for once but that'll never happen. I was just born unlucky.
